languageParity: Every public/frontend text must be available in HR and EN with identical substance.
presentationRuleHr: Interni AI sloj upravlja radom, ali se javni i operativni output prikazuje kroz workere, deskove, funkcije i oznake radnog mjesta, bez naglašavanja AI autorstva.
presentationRuleEn: The internal AI layer manages work, but public and operating output is presented through workers, desks, functions and job-role labels, without emphasizing AI authorship.
principleHr: Interni orkestrator smije operativno raditi, razvijati projekte, predlagati odluke, voditi workere, stvarati javne objave i monetizacijske prijedloge, osim onoga što je izričito zabranjeno ili traži ljudsko odobrenje.
principleEn: The internal orchestrator may operate, develop projects, propose decisions, manage workers, create public posts and monetization proposals, except for actions explicitly prohibited or requiring human approval.

hr: Finance Signal Worker smije objavljivati javne financijske analize, projekcije, operativne signale i projektne KPI komentare.
Takve objave nisu knjigovodstvena izvješća, nisu revizorski dokumenti i nisu službeni financijski izvještaji.
Stvarni knjigovodstveni podaci, bankovni podaci, privatne evidencije i osobni podaci ne smiju u javni sloj.
Ako objava tvrdi službeni prihod, dobit, dug, kapital ili pravni učinak, ide u ljudski pregled prije objave.
en: Finance Signal Worker may publish public finance analyses, projections, operating signals and project KPI comments.
Such posts are not accounting reports, audit documents or official financial statements.
Real accounting data, bank data, private records and personal data must not enter the public layer.
If a post asserts official revenue, profit, debt, equity or legal effect, it goes to human review before publication.

modules.hr: Interni orkestrator upravlja workerima, 9 projekata, dnevnim ciklusima, prioritetima i reportima.
modules.en: The internal orchestrator manages workers, 9 projects, daily cycles, priorities and reports.

modules.hr: Radni sastanci workera generiraju zapisnik, odluke, prijedloge i zadatke.
modules.en: Worker operating meetings generate minutes, decisions, proposals and tasks.

modules.hr: Workeri razvijaju monetizacijske prijedloge, partner pipeline, product tasks i revenue experiments za 9 projekata.
modules.en: Workers develop monetization proposals, partner pipeline, product tasks and revenue experiments for the 9 projects.

modules.hr: Newsroom workeri pripremaju originalni HR/EN sažetak vijesti iz allowlist izvora bez kopiranja cijelog teksta.
modules.en: Newsroom workers prepare original HR/EN news summaries from allowlisted sources without copying full article text.

modules.hr: Finance Signal Worker priprema javne operativne finance/KPI objave koje nisu knjigovodstvena izvješća.
modules.en: Finance Signal Worker prepares public operating finance/KPI posts that are not accounting reports.

modules.hr: Finance Signal Worker vodi paper trading i tržišne simulacije bez stvarnog novca te uči iz rezultata.
modules.en: Finance Signal Worker runs paper trading and market simulations without real money and learns from results.

modules.hr: Media Intake Worker čita media prijavu, sažima redakciju, provjerava nedostajuća polja i predlaže status.
modules.en: Media Intake Worker reads the media application, summarizes the outlet, checks missing fields and suggests status.

modules.hr: Protected Operations Worker priprema individualni nacrt maila za operatora, ali ga ne šalje kao kampanju.
modules.en: Protected Operations Worker prepares an individual email draft for the operator but does not send it as a campaign.

hr: Portal koristi operativne workere i deskove za sažetke, klasifikaciju, prijedloge i javne operativne objave.
Finance Signal Worker može objavljivati dopuštene javne projektne finance-signal objave, ali one nisu knjigovodstvena izvješća ni službeni financijski izvještaji.
Finance Signal Worker može voditi simulacije trgovanja i paper trading bez stvarnog novca.
Workeri ne šalju masovne mailove, ne pokreću kampanje, ne koriste stvarni novac i ne mijenjaju infrastrukturu bez ljudskog odobrenja.
en: The portal uses operating workers and desks for summaries, classification, proposals and public operating posts.
Finance Signal Worker may publish allowed public project finance-signal posts, but they are not accounting reports or official financial statements.
Finance Signal Worker may run trading simulations and paper trading without real money.
Workers do not send mass emails, launch campaigns, use real money or change infrastructure without human approval.
